name: What does a pool remodel typically involve?

mainEntity.name: What does a pool remodel typically involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pool remodel can encompass various improvements depending on its current condition and your vision. Common upgrades include resurfacing the pool interior with new plaster, pebble, or tile, updating the coping, and modernizing the deck with materials like pavers, concrete, or natural stone. Equipment upgrades such as energy-efficient pumps, filters, heaters, and automation systems are also popular. Aesthetic enhancements like water features, lighting, and landscaping can transform the pool area. The scope is tailored to enhance both functionality and visual appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pool remodel typically involves resurfacing, deck upgrades, equipment modernization, and aesthetic enhancements like water features and lighting to improve both function and appearance.
